Careers/Shopify Plus Engineer

Shopify Plus Engineer

Shopify Plus and headless. Speed, AOV, retention.

  • Remote
  • Contract
  • Senior, 4+ years on Shopify Plus
  • ₹5L to ₹10L a month, retainer
Apply for this roleAll open roles

The role

Run Shopify Plus engineering for our D2C brands: theme architecture, headless storefronts, app integrations and speed.

What you will own

  • Theme and headless storefront builds
  • Speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Klaviyo, Razorpay and GA4 integrations
  • Liquid, React and JavaScript

You probably are

  • 4+ years on Shopify Plus
  • You have shipped headless on a real brand
  • Comfortable with CI/CD and GitHub

A bonus if you have

  • Hydrogen or Oxygen
  • Next.js commerce

How hiring works

  1. 0130-minute screening call with the Head of Performance
  2. 02A 90-minute case study you complete on your own time
  3. 03Final round, a 2-hour panel with founders and the team you'd work with
  4. 04Reference checks and an offer within 7 days
